upstream_mode: broad framework suite with optional integrations, docs examples, browser tooling, native dependencies, and live transport fixtures
collection_policy: Every case emits exactly one unique leaf; missing, duplicate, extra, or malformed leaves invalidate grading.
excluded_reasons: Live transport and TestClient behavior require a broader HTTP client harness.
Multipart, templates, filesystem, CLI/cloud, databases, and external identity providers need optional dependencies or host resources outside the bounded NoNetwork contract.
